nodes.label: Function Trigger
nodes.rationale: A branch-scoped rule that POSTs to a Neon Function on a cron (type schedule) or when an object is created in a bucket (type storage_object_created). Same regions as Functions. Prefer a triggers map in neon.ts; the record key is the trigger name, and neon deploy applies triggers after the functions they target. Names must be unique among every trigger visible on the branch. Remote triggers omitted from neon.ts are left alone; delete them with neon triggers delete. Needs Neon CLI 4.21 or newer and @neon/config 1.7.0. CLI create takes --cron or --bucket, not both. Without --branch, get, update, enable, disable, and delete treat the trigger id as a branch name. Inherited triggers, created on a parent branch, show Inherited true on the child and start disabled. Deploying a neon.ts that declares the same trigger enables that copy; omit it to leave the inherited trigger disabled.

nodes.label: parseTriggerDelivery
nodes.rationale: Authenticates a trigger delivery. Import it from @neon/functions version 0.11.0 or newer. parseTrigger and parseTriggerInvocation stay schedule-only. The full payload and Hono example live in the neon-functions skill.
